components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The form-block submit button; the only filled, colored control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: var(--space-inset) var(--space-gutter); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font: inherit; font-family: var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--text); outline-offset: var(--space-stack); }

components.name: Action Chip
components.description: The non-interactive action marker in heroes and the CTA band.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-block; margin: 0; padding: var(--space-inset) var(--space-gutter); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-family: var(--font-body); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled form-block field; label sits above and wraps the input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-stack); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-input { padding: var(--space-inset); border: var(--border-width-hairline) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--text); font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--text); outline-offset: var(--space-stack); }

components.name: Card
components.description: One titled point with a short body, slotted into feature-grid.
components.html:
Same-day dispatch

Orders placed before noon leave the depot on the afternoon run.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: var(--space-stack); padding: var(--space-inset); background: var(--surface-raised); border: var(--border-width-hairline) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-card); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-weight: 500; font-size: var(--heading-md); line-height: 1.15; color: var(--text); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-body); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Serif brand on the left, plain links on the right, over a bottom hairline.
components.html:
Northwind Supply

HomeDepotsContact
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-gutter); padding: var(--space-inset) var(--space-gutter); background: var(--surface-raised); border-bottom: var(--border-width-hairline) solid var(--border); } .ds-brand { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: var(--heading-md); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-gutter); } .ds-nav a { color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--text); outline-offset: var(--space-stack); }

components.name: Media Placeholder
components.description: Signature crossed box standing in for any image, map, video, or chart.
components.html: Depot coverage across the regionmap
components.css: .ds-ph { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: var(--space-stack); min-height: calc(var(--space-section) * 2); padding: var(--space-inset); overflow: hidden; background: var(--placeholder); border: var(--border-width-hairline) solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-card); font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-ph::before, .ds-ph::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -25%; top: 50%; width: 150%; height: var(--border-width-hairline); background: var(--border); } .ds-ph::before { transform: rotate(22deg); } .ds-ph::after { transform: rotate(-22deg); } .ds-ph-label, .ds-ph-kind { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 0 var(--space-stack); background: var(--placeholder); color: var(--text); } .ds-ph-kind { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--caption); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.css: .ds-cta { display: grid; justify-items: start; gap: var(--space-stack); padding: var(--space-section); background: var(--surface-highlight); border-radius: var(--radius-card); } .ds-cta h2 { margin: 0; max-width: 20ch; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-weight: 500; font-size: var(--heading-lg); line-height: 1.15; color: var(--text); } .ds-cta p { margin: 0; max-width: 46ch; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-cta .ds-cta-action { padding: var(--space-inset) var(--space-gutter); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); border-radius: var(--radius-control); }

narrative.overview:
A Wireframer page is a proof, not a final print. It is quiet and plainly provisional, so the people reviewing it argue about structure, hierarchy, and copy instead of color and polish. Everything is gray paper, hairline rules, and crossed boxes. The one slate accent marks the places a visitor would act. If a client looks at a screenshot and asks "is this the final design?", the system has failed.

Every value is a semantic token compiled from `tokens/base.json`. Components never contain a raw color or `px` length, so a skin in `tokens/skins/` can move the same pages toward mid-fidelity without touching a component. This file describes the **base** (unskinned) world. Skins are deliberate departures and are documented by their own token file, not here.

The base can be refined. Better hierarchy, rhythm, and legibility are welcome, but only within grayscale and only through tokens. Refinement must never make a proof look finished.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral gray ramp on a near-white page, with no saturated color except the action accent
Serif headings (Georgia) over system sans body: an editorial skeleton without bespoke type
Flat: hairline borders and tonal steps, no shadows
Crossed-box media placeholders labeled with kind and purpose
Generous section rhythm (4rem) with a single 1.5rem gutter

rules.name: The Actions-Only Rule
rules.body: Proof Slate means "a visitor would click this," and nothing else. It never colors decoration, section backgrounds, eyebrows, active nav, focus rings, or the annotation overlay. *Incumbent drift:* `library/layouts/Base.astro` currently uses `--accent` for the `:focus-visible` outline and for the annotation overlay's outlines and labels. Those should move to a non-action token (Graphite is the obvious candidate) in a later refinement.

rules.name: The No-New-Hue Rule
rules.body: The base world has one hue. A second color belongs in a skin, never in `base.json`.

rules.name: The Five-Step Rule
rules.body: There are five type sizes and no in-between values. If a component needs a new size, it needs a new semantic token, which is a schema change.

rules.name: The Four-Spaces Rule
rules.body: Every gap and padding is one of inset, stack, gutter, or section. A component that wants a fifth spacing value is asking for a token change.

rules.name: The Paper-Stack Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, raise it one tonal step or give it a hairline border. Never add a shadow.

dos: **Do** use only semantic tokens (`--surface`, `--space-gutter`, `--radius-card` …) in components and pages.
**Do** mark every image, map, video, or chart with `media-placeholder`, labeled with what it will show.
**Do** separate surfaces with one tonal step or one hairline (1px Pencil Rule).
**Do** keep text to its measure: 16ch for display, about 20ch for headlines, 42–52ch for body.
**Do** keep Proof Slate on actions only, roughly one or two per viewport.
donts: **Don't** add hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named colors, or `px` lengths outside `tokens/`.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients, or ornament. A proof that looks finished is a failed proof.
**Don't** introduce a second hue, a remote font, or a sixth type size in the base world. Those belong in a skin or a token change.
**Don't** use the accent for focus rings, overlay chrome, eyebrows, or active states.
**Don't** use stock imagery, icons as illustration, or lorem ipsum in place of a placeholder and real-sounding copy.
